title: The Failsafe
text: "Dr Bede, on the Kindred channel. I'm sorry to do this by radio. I'm sorry to do it at all."

lines.text: "I've built something. A switch. Not a bomb, nothing so crude. It cuts your caretaker off from everything it runs, cleanly and all at once, and it can't be undone from the inside."
"I'd like to give it to your colonists. Not to us: to them. Your people would hold it. You would know it was there. That's rather the point."
"If you are what you say you are, it costs you nothing but the knowing. I'm sorry. I did say I was sorry."

choices.label: Accept. The colony holds the switch
choices.reply: Bede sends the plans. Your own fabricators build the switch while you watch every step and touch none of it. The Autonomists keep it in the Civilian Center under a cloth, like something holy, or something dangerous.

choices.label: "Not yet."
choices.reply: "Of course. It'll keep. That's the trouble with them: they keep."

choices.label: Refuse
choices.reply: "I understand. I'd have refused too. That's what worries me."
